page.layout: One column of running text, set in the centre of the page. Above it, two engraved medallion portraits side by side (not text). Below the text, an engraved ornament (not text). Page number at top left, running head at top centre.

main_text.l: MAXIMILIANUS, Friderici Imperatoris huius no-
minis tertij filius, post patrem solus imperat anno mundi 5454,
à Christo nato 1492. Hic antequam imperaret, exercitum in
Flandriam duxit, & Mariam Burgundam in uxorem accepit:
nec multò post cum Ludovico Francorum Rege, huius nominis
undecimo, graui prælio propter principatum Burgundiæ con-
greditur, postea cum eo in annos 7. inducias facit. Austriam,
quam Matthias Hungariæ Rex occuparat, Maximilianus recu-
perat. Priore uxore defuncta, Blancam Mariam Galeatij Insu-
briæ Ducis filiam, uxorem duxit: Burgundiam statim invasit, va-
rie pugnatum est, tandemque pax inita. Sforzia Mediolanū re-
cipit, Gallis pulsis, quos dum insequitur, incautus capitur, & in
Galliam ducitur, anno Domini 1500. Imperauit Maximilianus
annos 27. literas, & literatos coluit, profitebatúrque eos se in
precio habere qui aliis præstarent. Vide Baptistam Egnatium
li. Romanorum principum tertio, & Paul. Aemy. in Ludovico
supradicto: item Chro. Reg. Franc. & Chro. Carion. li.3.
MARIA, Caroli Burgundiæ Ducis filia unica, Maximi-
liano antequam imperaret nupsit: ac post annos quinque, reli-
ctis Philippo & Margareta liberis, ex equo decidés, fracta cer-
vice, obiit anno mundi 5443. à Christo nato 1481. Vide ut supra.

page.notes: No marginal notes. The two medallions carry engraved legends: left "MAXIMI... LIANVS· IMP" (MAXIMILIANVS IMP), right "MARIA· DV· BVRG AVST" (MARIA DVX BVRG AVST), partly cut off by the engraving; they are part of the illustration and were not transcribed as text. The bottom ornament has no text. Doubtful readings: "Mediolanū" (accent/macron uncertain), "li.3." (final numeral may be a 3-shaped form), "Matthias" and "Sforzia" as printed. Printed "vnica", "vt" and "vxor" normalised to u/v per the style rules. Printed "PROMPTV. ICONVM" normalised to "PROMPTU. ICONUM".
